description: Email for AI agents: throwaway inboxes, blocking on the verification email, and guardrailed outbound mail.

plugins.name: mailworker
plugins.description: Send and receive real email from an agent or a test — create a throwaway inbox, block until the verification message arrives, extract an OTP, and send outbound mail through policy gates. Requires your own Mailworker deployment on Cloudflare.
